description: This source file defines functionality for deleting a follower relationship in a social media or user profile system. It includes a command class, validation, and a request handler that interacts with a database context to remove a follower and return the updated profile.

classes.name: Delete
classes.description: Contains the command, validator, and handler for deleting a follower from a user profile.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the delete follower command by removing the follower relationship from the database and returning the updated profile.
